interactions.title: Lingering Effect ignores defenses once it lands
interactions.text: Once a hit LANDS, its Lingering DoT cannot be blocked or evaded and ticks off the hit's PRE-DEFENSE damage — only flat damage reduction applies (the hit itself can still miss to evasion). Dynamic difficulty pumps boss defenses toward the cap as you win; Lingering doesn't care. Multi-hit builds (Frenzy's 4 strikes, speed stackers) each stack independent 4s timers. Arguably the best anti-defense tech in the game.

interactions.title: Attack speed is uncapped and compounds
interactions.text: The old hidden 75% speed ceiling is gone — speed is a real rate with only a 50ms floor, and TREE speed multiplies gear speed independently (all tree stats compound with gear now). Gloves' tier cap is also gone (t100 Perfect = 130%). Past 100% total: Mage's Temporal Rift converts the excess to damage at 30-90% efficiency (Paradox adds crit at 15-45%); Warlock's Unstable Power converts to damage plus splash via Entropic Force. Excess is never wasted.

interactions.title: Dynamic difficulty punishes stomping
interactions.text: Boss power rubber-bands off your last 20 fights toward a ~5:2 win:loss ratio — a DOMINANT win ratchets boss stats up hard (tuned so the next fight is a likely loss), a close win barely moves it, losses ease it 15% each. Overkill no longer counts as dominance. Efficient play is winning UGLY. Separately: enemies focus players ABOVE the party's median level first, and catch-up multiplies lower-level players' pity payouts — running below the median means less incoming focus and boosted pity loot.

interactions.title: The 7-modifier item blueprint
interactions.text: Hard ceiling per item: 4 base modifiers + at most one each from Reforge's crit, Recombine's crit, and Krangle. Reforge's bonus-modifier crit scales with quality (2.2% on Perfect, once EVER per item, survives Recombine) — order: roll 4 mods, Polish to Perfect, spam targeted Reforge for the crit, Recombine-crit, Krangle last. From stage 200, Sacred bases add a maxed implicit outside the cap. Tier growth: the currency crafts (Transmute/Scour/Augment/Regal/Exalt/Krangle/Celestial Shard) each bump tier as a side effect (+3 under t25, +2 under t50, +1 after) — Recombine doesn't.

interactions.title: Overflow double-dipping
interactions.text: Every overflow node counts your COMBINED gear + archetype + tree total, and conversions pay ON TOP of the free baseline overflow-to-damage everyone gets. Rogue, Monk, and Druid each have THREE tree channels off the same overflow (e.g. Elusive + Phantom + Duskveil) — the same overcapped stat can pay out four times. Paladin reaches three, Warrior/Ranger two. Gear alone can carry the whole engine.

interactions.title: Echo chains snowball
interactions.text: Mage Spell Echo (75% trigger with Resonance, 80% damage with Echoing Power) re-triggers up to 9 deep via Finite Loop; Rogue Twin Strikes re-crits and re-triggers via Double Tap, same 9-repeat cap. Both live on crit chance — the closer to 100% crit, the closer the (geometric) chains get to their caps. Berserker's Chain Frenzy is the crit-free sibling: 4-strike Frenzy procs on ANY attack, chaining up to 3 deep.

interactions.title: The multiplicative club
interactions.text: Titan's Grip converts 100% of Juggernaut + Colossus's combined 48% tree HP into increased damage applied MULTIPLICATIVELY (33/66/100% per rank) — and the same patch made Overwhelming Force, Berserker's Reckless Swing/Death Wish, and Warlock's Life Tap stack multiplicatively too, compounding independently instead of blending into the shared additive pool. Points here out-scale identical-looking additive nodes.

interactions.title: Elemental procs — Lightning stacks +200% dmg taken
interactions.text: Fire/Cold/Lightning/Divine/Chaos rolls give flat damage plus a proc chance (roll ÷ 50) applying stacking 4s effects — Lightning stacks +1% damage taken per proc up to +200%, a debuff the WHOLE party benefits from. A healer's Fire/Cold/Chaos procs instead BUFF whoever they heal — pushing an ally's block/evasion past its cap feeds straight into their overflow conversions (patch-confirmed by design). Healer procs literally become tank damage.

interactions.title: Volley counts reachable targets — and now boosts everything
interactions.text: Volley grants +30% damage per target the attack CAN reach (not per hit) at 3/3, and reworked Chain Shot adds another +10% per rank (+30% at 3/3) to that same per-target bonus for the whole attack, splash included — +60%/target combined. Splash past 100% grants bonus targets, raising the reachable count again. Peak case per the wiki: the Lich raises 5 skeletons every 2s, up to 20 in one fight — every one is a Volley multiplier. Rangers should pray for Lich fights.

interactions.title: Healing-power flywheel
interactions.text: Healing power above 100% converts into ACTION FREQUENCY — interval = 1.7s ÷ (1 + excess), so 300% healing power is three actions in the time of one, stacking with glove/archetype speed. (Wild Surge would shorten it further but is still marked inactive — points there bank, not pay.) Evergrowth converts 9% of total healing power into Lingering and Seed of Life turns every tick into shields. Paladin's Holy Fire double-dips the same stat as party-wide damage. Divine procs add stacking +healing done up to +200% — more output, though it doesn't feed Evergrowth's conversion.

interactions.title: Slayer ignores the leech cap
interactions.text: Endless Thirst at 3/3 removes the leech-per-second cap entirely during FlickerStrike windows; Hemorrhage explodes for 80% of ALL damage dealt to the wounded target and its Overflow leech explicitly bypasses the cap too. Combined with Bloodpact firing quadruple-damage hits every ~2s (Blood Sacrifice), sustain scales with damage with no ceiling.

interactions.title: Party-wide damage-taken amplification
interactions.text: Curse of Weakness 20% + Amplify Curse 24% + Hex Mastery 24% = up to +68% damage taken by the target from EVERYONE, spread via Contagious Curse, then Doom detonates for 105% of damage dealt (with Harbinger) and Apocalypse splashes 90% of that. In a full party this is arguably the strongest force-multiplier — every ally's hit gets the amp.

interactions.title: Fight the right fights
interactions.text: Cthulhu's bubble crushes whoever currently leads the damage meter by 90% for the rest of the fight, and it follows the lead — spread damage, don't carry. Helm gear is a STACKING dps buff the longer you survive, and boss HP is 10x — long fights favor sustain over glass (theorycraft, not patch-stated). A DPS Celestial Shard wielder gets a 10% replay hit on every landed hit that triggers leech and elemental procs. Wings of Flight makes you immune to slam knockback for full attack uptime.

interactions.title: Opportunist rework: three unstoppable openers
interactions.text: Post-rework, your first 1/2/3 hits each fight are guaranteed to land (no evade, no block), and Ambush strips up to ~100% of the target's damage reduction on those same hits — all three openers bypass evasion, block, AND damage reduction (shields and raw HP still apply). Pairs with Assassinate's banked guaranteed crits for the hardest-hitting opener available.

interactions.title: Unbroken Prayer chains one heal across the whole party
interactions.text: Live per the patch: Prayer of Mending bounces (35% chance at 3/3) can themselves bounce again at 45% per hop via Unbroken Prayer — a single heal CAN chain across the whole party, though it's a probability cascade, not a guarantee. With Divine Favor shielding every bounce target and Merciful Touch at 80% bounce value, a lucky cast becomes party-wide sustain plus shields.
